fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Junior Assistant 12/2024 Revised Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Details : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the revised answer key for the Junior Assistant Post. This recruitment was released for 3284 posts. The applications for UPSSSC Junior Assistant Recruitment 2024 were accepted from December 23, 2024, to January 22, 2025. The written examination is scheduled to be conducted on February 01, 2026. Candidates who have applied for this recruitment can download their UPSSSC Junior Assistant12/2024 Revised Answer Key 2026 from the link provided below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 26 November 2024
  • Application Start Date : 23 December 2024
  • Last Date : 22 January 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 January 2025
  • Correction Last Date : 29 January 2025
  • Exam Date : 01 February 2026
  • Exam City Details : 22 February 2026
  • Admit Card : 28 January 2026
  • Answer Key : 02 February 2026
  • Revised Answer Key : 13 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, BC : Rs. 25/-
  • PH (Divyang) : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
